glosses: Faire un remix (d’un morceau de musique).

examples.text: C’est une habitude de la personnalisation automobile que de reprendre les mythes et les symboles de la culture populaire mondiale, surtout américaine, et de les remixer jusqu’à les épuiser.

glosses: A rearrangement of an older piece of music, possibly including various cosmetic changes.
A piece of music formed by combining existing pieces of music together, possibly including various other cosmetic changes

examples.text: Overhauling serves to remix the brine and to shift the meat so that all pieces will be exposed to the brine.

glosses: To rearrange or radically alter (a particular piece of music).
To modify (a work in any medium).

examples.text: It is essential that we maintain focus on originality as an ethical issue. A broader idea of creativity does not mean that 'anything goes' and sometimes attempts to reuse or remix the work of others becomes an ethical, even a legal, problem […]
